dct_description_sm: Three 0.25 ha plots were established at treeline in southwest Yukon in order to characterize the spatial pattern and size of white spruce (Picea glauca). In addition, treeline is anticipated to advance in response to climate warming and these plots have been permanently marked to act as benchmarks against which change can be measured in the future. They also acted as ground-truth references for satellite imagery obtained during the IPY period.
dct_title_s: Permanent Plot Data from Treeline in southwest Yukon
